description: Store conversation context in agent memory with automatic importance scoring and embedding. Supports multi-session tracking and memory decay.

content.description: The content to store in memory (conversation text, facts, preferences, etc.)

metadata.description: Additional metadata to store with the memory

role.description: Role of the speaker (affects importance scoring)

session_id.description: Session identifier to organize memories by conversation

user_id.description: Optional user identifier for cross-session memory

name: zerodb_store_memory
